arduino-shield.title: Arduino Shield
arduino-shield.summary: Custom Arduino Shield extending standard boards with servo, MOSFET, temperature sensor, and flexible power selection.
arduino-shield.detail: This custom Arduino Shield is designed to extend the functionality of standard Arduino boards with a clean and compact form factor. The shield features dual servo motor headers (SERVO 1 & SERVO 2), a MOSFET header for driving high-current loads, and a dedicated temperature sensor interface. It includes a flexible power selection system allowing the user to choose between external supply and 15V onboard regulation, along with clearly labeled analog and digital breakout pins. A user LED and power LED provide real-time status indication.
notes: MOSFET header for driving high-current loads
Flexible power selection: external or 15V onboard regulation
User LED + power LED for real-time status indication

atmega328.title: ATmega328 IC Board
atmega328.summary: Standalone ATmega328P-PU board offering a complete Arduino-compatible development platform without a full Arduino board.
atmega328.detail: This standalone ATmega328P-PU microcontroller board offers a complete Arduino-compatible development platform without the need for a full Arduino board. Built around the ATmega328P-PU DIP IC running at 16MHz with a dedicated crystal oscillator and 22pF load capacitors, it features dual LM340H-05 voltage regulators for stable 5V power from a 9V input, a fuse for overcurrent protection, a reset button, and dual servo output headers.
notes: ATmega328P-PU at 16MHz with crystal oscillator & 22pF caps
Dual LM340H-05 regulators - stable 5V from 9V input
Fuse for overcurrent protection + reset button
Port B (PB0-PB5) breakout + dual servo output headers

ac-switch.title: Automatic AC Switch
ac-switch.summary: Intelligent PIR-based AC switching board using Arduino Nano and an onboard HLK-5M05 power module - no external adapter needed.
ac-switch.detail: This intelligent Automatic AC Switch PCB uses a PIR223D-S0 passive infrared sensor paired with an Arduino Nano to automatically control AC-powered devices based on motion detection. The board incorporates an HLK-5M05 AC-to-DC power module to derive a clean 5V supply directly from mains, eliminating the need for an external adapter. A BC547B transistor drives an SRD-05VDC relay to switch the AC output.
notes: PIR223D-S0 sensor + Arduino Nano for motion detection
HLK-5M05 AC-to-DC module - no external adapter needed
BC547B transistor drives SRD-05VDC relay for AC switching
1N4007 flyback diode for relay coil protection

pressure-sensing.title: Pressure Sensing System
pressure-sensing.summary: Medical-grade multi-point pressure mapping PCB built around an ESP32 module for bed sore prevention and patient monitoring.
pressure-sensing.detail: This advanced Pressure Sensing System PCB is engineered for medical-grade patient monitoring applications, featuring a dense and well-organized layout built around an ESP32 38-pin module as the central processing unit. The board integrates multiple pressure sensor interfaces distributed symmetrically across all four edges of the PCB, enabling real-time multi-point pressure mapping. An MUX (analog multiplexer) handles the numerous sensor inputs efficiently.
notes: ESP32 38-pin module as central processing unit
Multi-point pressure sensors symmetrically on all four PCB edges
Analog multiplexer (MUX) for efficient sensor input management
Wi-Fi & Bluetooth via ESP32 for wireless data transmission
